companyDescription: Defense comms/cybersecurity microcap · SkyHopper PRO + ICE Electronic Warfare Resistance & Cybersecurity Suite now shipping on a monthly delivery cadence under a $249M, 5-year DoD Program of Record with a Tier-1 U.S. drone manufacturer, plus new Israeli and Asia-Pacific Tier-1 design wins — debt-free, no active ATM, but H1 2026 net loss widened sharply as opex scaled ahead of revenue
priceNote: Live $2.40 on Nov 11, 2026, -21.4% vs the Nov 4 report ($3.055), near the bottom of its 52-week range, with no company news. Base cut from +50% to +40% because the slide is information. The Q3 results update is due Nov 12.
summary: Refresh: the stock fell -21.4% in a week on no company news. The only items were a Nov 5 UVID DroneTech showcase and October SwarmiX launches. The Sep 15 $200M mixed shelf is ~6x the ~$31M market cap, a large dilution overhang for a company whose H1 net loss widened to $6.7M and whose confirmed backlog was ~$1.0M at Jun 30. The Q3 update tomorrow (Nov 12) is the test: DoD Program-of-Record delivery revenue has to show up. partnership_win is the Tier-2 laggard in both lanes (turbo -3.8pp vs +2.0, n=16), so conviction is low. Base is cut from +50% to +40%. Base bias +72.7pp vs realized 30d P75 +12.2%, so Base is a post-catalyst horizon, not a 30-day call. แนะนำ 1% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50–80%.

catalysts.name: Next Results Update (Q3 2026)
catalysts.description: TipRanks lists Nov 12, 2026 as the confirmed next results date. Key read: whether the H1 2026 net loss widening ($6.69M vs $0.07M prior year) is stabilizing as the DoD program's monthly delivery cadence scales, or whether opex keeps outrunning revenue conversion.

catalysts.name: $249M DoD Program of Record — Now at Monthly Delivery Cadence
catalysts.description: SkyHopper PRO/ICE systems moved from episodic purchase orders to a monthly delivery cadence under the 5-year, $249M program with a Tier-1 U.S. drone manufacturer selling to the Department of War. Ongoing structural driver behind every quarterly print from here.

catalysts.name: New Design-Win Pipeline (Israel + Asia-Pacific)
catalysts.description: Aug 5 Tier-1 Israeli defense design win (loitering munitions) and Sept 14 follow-on production order from an Asia-based Tier-1 robotics customer — the first real evidence of geographic diversification beyond the single U.S. DoD customer concentration risk.

risks: Financing overhang: the $200M mixed shelf (Sep 15, 2026) is ~6x the ~$31M market cap, with H1 2026 net loss of $6.7M and ~$1.0M confirmed backlog at Jun 30. Expect dilution on any strength.
H1 2026 net loss widened to $6.69M (from $0.07M in H1 2025) as opex surged to $9.31M against only 19% revenue growth. Nov 12 needs to show this stabilizing.

partnership_win is the measured Tier-2 LAGGARD in turbo feedback (medianExcessVsBenchPct -3.8pp vs +2.0pp overall, n=16; 3/16 windows had SPY down >2%), and it is independently the laggard in the core lane too (-1.6 vs +1.4, n=12). Design-win and order headlines haven't reliably produced sustained re-rates lane-wide.
Cash $15.08M (Jun 30) gives ~18-25 months of runway with no active ATM found, but a ~$41M company can't sustain this burn trajectory indefinitely.
Thin liquidity (tens of thousands of dollars in daily volume) — both entries and exits can move the price sharply.
Customer concentration: the Tier-1 U.S. drone manufacturer remains the single largest revenue driver.

estimateDates.note: Confirmed per TipRanks — key read is whether the H1 net-loss widening trend is stabilizing as the DoD program's monthly delivery cadence scales

catalystSpot.preRunup: No run-up: MOB fell ~33% since Sep 29 despite a September follow-on Ground Control Station order from its Asia-based robotics customer.

postWin.note: Kratos Defense (KTOS) ran +380% after its Jan 2026 Marine Corps CCA (Valkyrie) program-of-record win — still the clearest same-sector precedent for what a confirmed DoD program-of-record win can do. MOB's own Aug 13 H1 print (revenue +19% YoY, DoD program moving to monthly delivery cadence) produced a same-week +6.09% pop on 4.5x volume but has since faded to a net -9.9% drift by Sept 29 — the market wants bookings conversion outpacing loss growth, not just design-win headlines, to sustain a re-rate.

postLose.note: No confirmed MOB-specific hard-negative catalyst precedent exists yet, but the post-Aug-13 fade (a +6.09% day-one pop fully reversed and then some within seven weeks) is itself a soft-negative precedent: even a genuinely positive print with real order-flow can't hold a re-rate once net losses widen faster than revenue.

spotSizing.reason: 1%. partnership_win is the cross-lane Tier-2 laggard (turbo -3.8pp vs +2.0, n=16), a -21% slide on no news, and a shelf ~6x the market cap put it at the minimum.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the partnership_win medianMAE (-25.9%, n=16). A break below ~$2.23 means the market sees no stabilization.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Nov 12 shows losses still widening without revenue acceleration, exit.
